payload.gloss: an entity naming the set of concepts it realizes and its lifecycle: proposed, bound, then closed, which is final. One live plan per name, and a closed plan keeps its name. Binding a plan returns whichever plan was bound to proposed, so at most one plan is bound, and when a merge leaves two, binding the one to keep resolves it. An owed ruling that names a plan blocks binding it and every unit in it. A closed plan and its units are never written again, and stay readable forever; closing replaces retiring by deletion.
